name: Breaker operating-time trend interface
summary: Associates the measured operating-time history with the assigned breaker mechanism.
description: Associates the measured operating-time history with the assigned breaker mechanism. Yard equipment supervision carries the condition and support-system information of primary equipment into station alarms. A monitor's declared alarm, measurement and self-fault output need separate point names.

In a switchyard marshalling kiosk, gas compartment, operating mechanism and cabinet-service indications are collected for the station controller. Their equipment tags identify the actual compartment or mechanism being monitored. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Command and contact timing events” at the input and “Operating-time trend” at the output. A trend is not an automatic serviceability decision.

Keep primary-device identity, compartment boundaries and monitor health visible. A monitoring illustration does not establish a leak rate, operating threshold or remaining equipment life. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
